item.title: pHathom Technologies Closes Successful Seed Financing Round
item.description: pHathom Technologies, a climate technology company developing carbon capture solutions for existing coastal bioenergy and industrial facilities, announced the closing of its seed financing round. The capital will accelerate the development and deployment of pHathom’s platform for verifiable carbon capture and durable storage using existing coastal infrastructure. Combined with its lead role in the $16 million Bioenergy Carbon Capture and Marine Storage Project through Canada’s Ocean Supercluster

item.title: Lloyd’s Register Strengthens Leadership Team in China with New Appointments
item.description: Lloyd’s Register (LR) has further enhanced its capabilities in China and deepened its commitment to Chinese clients, with the announcement of three new senior appointments.

item.title: Jacket Loadout Milestone Completed for Borwin6 Offshore HVDC Platform
item.description: Progress on the BorWin6 Project continues with the successful completion of a key fabrication yard milestone in Jebel Ali, United Arab Emirates. Mammoet has completed the transport, loadout, and mooring of the 5,461-tonne offshore jacket foundation, destined to support the BorWin6 offshore converter platform BorWin kappa in the German North Sea.

item.title: Kongsberg Maritime Demerger to Reposition Company as a Global Technology Partner
item.description: As previously announced, Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (KONGSBERG) will demerge Kongsberg Maritime as a separate publicly listed company. The decision was approved at an Extraordinary General Meeting in KONGSBERG on January 22, 2026, and Kongsberg Maritime is planned to be listed on Euronext Oslo Børs in April 2026.

item.title: Sentinel Subsea Wins Technology Development Award at the 2026 Subsea Expo Awards
item.description: Sentinel Subsea Ltd (Sentinel), developer of passive subsea well integrity monitoring solutions, has announced that it has won the Technology Development Award at the 2026 Subsea Expo Awards, held on February 4, 2026, in Aberdeen.

item.title: Kongsberg Maritime Contracted for Transpetro’s New Tanker Fleet
item.description: Kongsberg Maritime has been contracted by Consórcio Marenova to design and equip four methanol/ethanol-ready handy-size product tankers. The vessels will be built at Consórcio Marenova, a partnership between Ecovix in Rio Grande and MacLaren in Niterói, Brazil. The vessels will be operated by Petrobras Transporte S.A (Transpetro).

item.title: TotalEnergies Expands Its Exploration Portfolio as Operator of PEL104 License
item.description: TotalEnergies has signed agreements to acquire a 42.5% operated interest in PEL104 Exploration license, located offshore Namibia, from Eight Offshore Investments Holdings (“Eight) and Maravilla Oil & Gas.

item.title: Fincantieri and WSense to Co-Develop Technological and Commercial Wireless Solution
item.description: Fincantieri has announced the signing of a strategic agreement with WSense, an Italian deep tech company, aimed at strengthening the Group’s capabilities in offering cutting-edge systems for the underwater domain. The agreement provides, on one hand, for the co-development of advanced wireless technological solutions for the underwater sector and, on the other, a commercial agreement for their application to environmental monitoring through Fincantieri Infrastructure.

item.title: Longitude Targets Cost Efficiencies with New PSV Design
item.description: Design and engineering consultancy Longitude has launched a compact “D-Flex” platform supply vessel (PSV) design—the second design in its IMT Isca series.

item.title: Silicon Sensing Expands Distribution Agreement with Althen Sensors & Controls
item.description: Silicon Sensing has announced the expansion of the company’s distribution agreement with Althen Sensors & Controls, further strengthening their long-standing partnership that continues to deliver exceptional value to customers worldwide.
